title: teratophyllum articulatum
intro: Teratophyllum articulatum, commonly known as the Spiny Wood Fern, is a species of fern native to Southeast Asia. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and lower blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Teratophyllum articulatum are attributed to its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe digestive issues, calm muscle spasms, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
